notes: לִפְנֵי → Before fused on the construct (rule 30); object marker and paragogic he tokens unrepresented (rules 16, 32); לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּנוּ → 'to save us' gives 'to' to the first לְ, 'save' to the noun rendered as a verb, and leaves the dative לְ unrepresented with the suffix taking 'us' (rule 40).
